cues.en:
This is the "Players' Shop",
just for "Battle Live-G" players!

Here, in exchange for the GP you earn in missions,
we offer "Gunpla" with a full set of machine parts,

"Avatars" that are you in the VR Hangar,
and more.

However, under the battle event's rules,
for the "Gunpla",

The Gunpla and avatars you can get
are added one after another as you progress.

We'll send you a mail when new items arrive,
so check your Breakers Mobile.

You can also trade the runners you won in battle
and the parts you made for GP.

If you have runners or parts you don't need,
bring them here.
